verdict.rationale: Greptile's docs say every PR review is done with "complete understanding of your codebase." It maintains a synthesized repository knowledge base, indexes existing rule files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, cursor.rules) and style guides as review context, and supports directory-scoped team context, so existing conventions are well covered. Hands-on reports are mixed: one user found it located the right file deep in a large repo, and one user's employer says it catches real PR issues. Another user found its codebase answers incomplete or incorrect on C++ templates, which lowers confidence. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that review comments trace call sites and related modules outside the diff, and independent hands-on corroboration of cross-file reasoning in PR review specifically.
